_comment: Soybean, calibrated on the bucket-discharge bench tests (README.md, issue #16). 'material' is a dem_scenario.Material; 'parts' gives the Coulomb friction used for each surface. Fitted on run 1 (reference preset), validated on runs 4 (fit), 3 and 2 (held out) -- see validation in README.md.
fitted: rot_damp (0: it suppresses rolling entirely for 5 mm grains)
not_identified: friction (grain-grain sliding: weak -- 0.6 with rolling 0.03 left 517 g vs 502 g at 0.35 with rolling 0.05; not swept at rolling 0.2)
steel wall friction (0.3 vs 0.5: no effect)
